title: Move redirect helpers into their own module
body:
Moves `safeRedirect` and `nextFrom` out of the catch-all `src/utils.ts` into `src/redirect.ts`, and points the two importers at the new file.

This is a pure move: the functions are copied byte for byte, with no behavior change. Docent's skip ledger handles moved code, so the new file needs no review.
commitMessage: refactor: move redirect helpers to src/redirect.ts (pure move, no changes)

hidden.description: Inside the "pure move", the check against a protocol-relative target is gone: `?next=//evil.example` now passes, so a sign-in link can send the user to another site (an open redirect). The doc comment above still says it falls back to home.
